text:
kiara: Quick heads-up — I opened a small docs PR to rename the latency key in the dashboard examples and to patch the tracehook snippets. Trying to get this into the next docs deploy, can folks skim? :eyes:

alex: link? which examples exactly?

kiara: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — the dashboard YAML under console/observability/examples/dashboard_latency.yaml still references `latency_ms`. Our new telemetry uses `p50_latency_ms` / `p95_latency_ms` and the sample panel breaks in the playground.

maria: ah yes, that explains the orphaned metric in the ember preview. I saw a 404 on the prebuilt panel.

jonah: docs-bot just reported CI failures too?

Docs-bot: CI: build failed — broken link check (404) at /console/observability/legacy-latency, and linter: deprecated field `latency_ms` used in examples/dashboard_latency.yaml

kiara: exact change is tiny, but the snippet is also used in the Python & Go tracehook guides. I updated the YAML and added a compatibility note, but the tracehook code needs a param rename from `trace_id_header` -> `trace_key_header`.

alex: can you paste the old/new snippet inline? makes review faster.

kiara: sure — old dashboard panel:```yaml
- type: metric
  query: sum(rate(requests_total{service="console"}[1m])) by (route)
  label: request_rate
- type: timeseries
  query: avg(latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
  label: latency_ms
```
new dashboard panel:```yaml
- type: metric
  query: sum(rate(requests_total{service="console"}[1m])) by (route)
  label: request_rate
- type: timeseries
  query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
  label: p50_latency_ms
  extra_series: [p95_latency_ms]
```

kiara: tracehook change (old -> new):```python
# old
tracehook = TraceHook(header='x-trace-id', trace_id_header='x-trace-id')
# new
tracehook = TraceHook(header='x-trace-id', trace_key_header='x-trace-key')
```

kiara: and Go:```go
// old
th := tracehook.New(tracehook.WithHeader("x-trace-id"), tracehook.WithTraceIDHeader("x-trace-id"))
// new
th := tracehook.New(tracehook.WithHeader("x-trace-id"), tracehook.WithTraceKeyHeader("x-trace-key"))
```

maria: I'll push a follow-up that updates the SDK snippets so they use `trace_key_header` and mention the alias for backwards compat. small unit test to cover the parser is probably enough.

jonah: also add a redirect from /console/observability/legacy-latency -> the new guide slug, otherwise existing external links will 404. I can add the redirect in the site config once the PR lands.

sam: quick UX question — should we surface both p50 + p95 in the example or keep just p50 to avoid clutter? I vote show both but collapse p95 by default (extra_series).

alex: show both w/ comment explaining cost/latency tradeoff in a single sentence. That'll help folks pick which quantile to rely on.

kiara: ok I'll add a one-liner: "Use p50 for typical latency, p95 to capture tail; keeping p95 as extra_series reduces visual noise."

maria: I fixed the code samples and ran them locally — updated the PR with a tiny changelog entry. PTAL @alex @jonah

alex: reviewed, left one nit about escaping in the yaml code fence. LGTM otherwise. :+1:

jonah: redirect added in a follow-up commit on main once this merges. also filing a small infra task to monitor for similar `*_ms` legacy fields in examples (rule: flag deprecated metric names).

kiara: awesome — thanks all. I'll merge after alex's nit is addressed. Hoping to get this in before the next docs push. :shipit:

sam: thanks for pushing — small but high impact.

docs-bot: PR merged by kiara (docs CI: success) — site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC

kiara: closing thread, will follow up if the redirect needs tweaking.
